title: My PE Class
text: Every Friday, we have a PE class at school. My favorite sport is soccer, but today we played baseball instead. I held the bat and hit the ball hard. My whole team cheered loudly for me. After the game, we had a fun race around the gym, but I did not win. I still had a great time with my classmates.
